summary: I am a NOC Engineer and an eJPT-certified penetration testing practitioner, currently pursuing a double-degree Master's in Cyber Security through the EIT Digital Master School. I have hands-on experience in NOC and MSSP operations, IT/OT security monitoring, incident response, firewall administration, and endpoint security, complemented by practical offensive and defensive security skills gained through certifications, Hack The Box, TryHackMe, and personal projects.

experience.title: NOC Cyber Security Engineer
responsibilities: Monitoring: Continuously monitoring network performance to detect and respond to anomalies, outages, and inefficiencies; System Health Checks: Ensuring the health and status of servers, routers, switches, firewalls, and other critical infrastructure components; Alert Management: Analyzing and responding to alerts generated by network management systems and other monitoring tools.

Incident Response: Identifying, diagnosing, and resolving network issues to minimize downtime; Document incidents, service requests, change approvals, and investigation results in ticketing platforms.

Maintenance: Performing routine maintenance, updates, patches, and network security changes, including firewall modifications, VPN investigations, access validation, and post-change verification, to maintain current configurations and service stability.
Troubleshooting infrastructure issues across Linux systems, containerized services, high-availability environments, and network components.

Participating in on-call support, responding to urgent alerts, service outages, and high-impact incidents outside regular business hours. Handling critical incidents by coordinating escalations, communicating with stakeholders, and validating service restoration and stability.

experience.title: Network Operations Center Analyst Intern
responsibilities: Completed practical training through the Cyber TechTrek program in endpoint security, networking, cryptography, Linux, vulnerability management, email security, incident response, OSINT, EDR, threat intelligence, threat hunting, traffic analysis, and introductory forensics.
Selected to join the NOC team and contributed to real network monitoring and analysis activities.

experience.title: Software Engineer Intern
responsibilities: Developed a cybersecurity news application integrating external APIs to retrieve, process, and display security-related articles.
Built backend functionality with Spring Boot and Python scripts for cross-module interactions and workflow automation.

experience.title: Embedded Software Engineer Intern
responsibilities: Developed a C++ train railway crossing simulation with synchronized train, road signal, and barrier control.
Implemented real-time visualization with Qt and concurrent event management with QThread and QTimer.

experience.title: Full-Stack Software Developer Intern
responsibilities: Developed ONG Manager, a full-stack application for NGO projects, events, volunteers, and reports.
Built REST APIs with Java, Spring Boot, JPA, Hibernate, and PostgreSQL, documented with Swagger and validated with Postman.
Developed responsive frontend modules using Angular, Ionic, NgRx, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, and JavaScript.

projects.title: ICS/OT Cyber Security Lab
responsibilities: Designed and implemented an isolated ICS/OT lab using Factory I/O, OpenPLC Runtime, Kali Linux, Suricata IDS, Node-RED, Conpot, and Docker.
Simulated an industrial tank process over Modbus TCP and developed PLC logic, process variable mappings, register configurations, and a remote command register.
Performed controlled Modbus TCP attacks with mbpoll and Metasploit, created Suricata rules for unauthorized writes, and correlated IDS alerts with cyber-physical impact.
Deployed a Conpot honeypot and analyzed Modbus traffic with Wireshark and tcpdump.

projects.title: Secure Web Infrastructure and DevOps Lab
responsibilities: Built and deployed a containerized Flask application with authentication, session management, route protection, and email verification.
Used Docker Compose for multi-container orchestration, networks, volumes, secrets, and service isolation.
Configured Nginx reverse proxying, least-connections load balancing, and HTTPS/TLS termination with OpenSSL certificates.
Implemented MariaDB/MySQL master-slave replication, Mailpit SMTP testing, centralized logs, AWStats traffic analysis, and internal DNS service discovery.
